title: Ball Under a Parked Car
question: Your tee shot comes to rest underneath a parked car on the edge of the course. The car is preventing you from playing your ball. What is the correct ruling?

choices.text: You must play the ball as it lies.
You may move the car if it can be readily moved. If it cannot be readily moved, you are entitled to free relief.
You must take an unplayable ball with a one-stroke penalty.
You may always take free relief, whether the car can be moved or not.

explanation: A parked car is an obstruction. If the car can be readily moved, it is a movable obstruction: move the car and play the ball. If the car cannot readily be moved, it is treated as an immovable obstruction and you are entitled to free relief. This is covered by Rules 15.2a (Relief from Movable Obstructions) and 16.1 (Relief from Immovable Obstructions).

juniorVersion.title: Ball Stuck Under a Car
juniorVersion.question: You hit your ball and it stops under a parked car next to the golf course. The car is blocking you from hitting your ball. What should you do?

choices.text: You must hit the ball from where it is.
If you can move the car easily, move it and hit your ball. If you cannot move the car, you get a free drop.
You must say your ball is unplayable and take one extra shot.
You can always get a free drop, even if you could move the car.

juniorVersion.explanation: A parked car is called an obstruction. If you can move it easily, you should do that and then play your ball. If you cannot move the car, you can pick up your ball and drop it nearby without a penalty.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: Something man-made on the course, like a car or a bench, that can block your play.
You are allowed to move your ball without losing a shot.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Show kids real examples of movable and immovable things on the course and ask what they would do with a ball behind them.
likelyMisconceptions: Some may think you always have to play the ball where it is, even if it’s under a car.
Some may think you never get free relief from anything in the way.
Some might think you always get a free drop, even when you could just move something away.
